verdict.rationale: Zep's concepts docs list a Custom Entity/Edge Types feature that uses Pydantic-like classes to customize how entities and relations are created and retrieved in the Context Graph. The Graphiti repo also states support for both prescribed and learned ontology, which covers the entity-type, edge-type and ontology parts of the story. An early HN thread said custom schema was not yet implemented, but this predates the current documented feature and is a historical request, not a hands-on failure. Missing for 10: in-depth docs or examples of defining domain schemas (field types, constraints, RDF/OWL-style ontology import), and independent hands-on corroboration that custom types work as described.
